services.desc: Our Cultural Center serves as the prime space for events in downtown Cleveland. This gorgeous area is host to extravagant galas, unforgettable weddings, and illustrious corporate events. LED lighting, projectors and screens, and sound system is available in this room. Enjoy the beautiful weather and sunshine out in our Courtyard & Grounds. This beautiful outdoor space with our bistro lights is perfect for cocktail hours, weddings and rehearsals along with dinner! The Courtyard & Grounds are available to rent on their own or as an adjunct space off the Cultural Center or Education Room.
